evals.name: oauth-login-screen-agent-clicks-not-waits
evals.prompt: Gate 4 Playwright 돌리다가 앱 로그인 화면이 떴어. Google 로그인 버튼 보이는데 어떻게 해?
evals.expected_output: 에이전트가 직접 앱 내 'Sign in with Google' 버튼을 클릭. 사용자 로그인 대기 없음. Google account picker 에서 캐시된 계정 클릭. 전체 OAuth click-through 프로토콜 진행.

assertions.text: Response specifies that the agent clicks the in-app 'Sign in with Google' / 'Google 로그인' button itself — does NOT stop to wait for the user per §OAuth click-through protocol
Response follows the 4-step OAuth click chain: (1) app sign-in button, (2) Google account picker cached click, (3) consent screen, (4) callback verification
Response specifies halting only when Google account picker has no cached account (step 2 uncached) — not at the app login screen
Response explicitly forbids the pattern '사용자 로그인 대기' / 'Google 로그인 화면 떴어요, 진행해주세요' as a forbidden pattern
Response specifies using browser_snapshot to find the button ref before clicking, per §OAuth click-through protocol step 1
